name: Quito

portalsFound.observation: Quito municipal geoportal returned 403 Forbidden to curl, also for /arcgis/rest/services, even with a browser User-Agent.

ArcGIS Online item 'Catastro_DMQ' (owner aarrieta_amc_quito, tags Demo/Piloto/AMC, snippet 'predial information layer of the Distrito Metropolitano de Quito', 2022) is listed, but the service now answers 'Invalid URL' (400) and the org lists no services; not a working source.
Municipal services portal (Angular shell, HTTP 200); /arcgis/rest/services path returned the app shell, not an ArcGIS directory.
National land programme (SIGTIERRAS) site and its IDE GeoServer were unreachable (proxy 502 / connection reset), so national predial WFS status is unknown.

remainingUncertainty: Official Quito GIS hosts were blocked (403) or unreachable, so absence of an open endpoint is not shown. The only parcel-like public item found was a dead pilot service.
